plan: OpenVibe Development Roadmap (combined), Wave 1; implementation plan rev 3 section 3.1
deployment: none of its own: a library and artifact repository published as release tags; services pin a tag and deploy it with their own releases
contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.126.0 (this package; the newest tag)
features: 589 JSON Schemas with valid and invalid fixtures
31 service manifests with lifecycle declarations
205 capability manifests and the staff capability map
13 user-module namespace manifests
validate, ids, http (problem+json, trace and idempotency middleware), capabilities.check and serviceAuth
openvibe-contracts-check for service CI
generated TypeScript types, JSON Schema bundle and per-service OpenAPI 3.1
compatibility check against the previous tag (scripts/compat.js)
documentation-currency check (scripts/docs-currency.js)
generated estate: docs/ESTATE.md and manifests/repositories/ from the checkouts (scripts/estate.js; --check fails on drift)

chat.ticket-conversation@1 and the active chat.ticket.write capability: a per-ticket conversation keyed by ticket id and calling service, with author_kind person|agent|staff (POST /internal/chat/tickets/:ticket_id/messages and GET /internal/chat/tickets/:ticket_id)
chat.dm-block-state-result@1: Chat's DM block-state read ({ blocked }, GET /internal/chat/dm/block-state) joined to chat.messages.read's route list
platform.task@1 (planned, owner network) and ADR-044: one task at OpenVibe.Actor's router with a mode, a per-task and per-day budget, result, cost and explanation, SSE progress, cancel and webhooks

watch.watch@1 and the other Watch contracts (plan T18, planned), three watch events, four capabilities and the placeholder service manifest: user-defined persistent observations over pages, feeds, APIs, events and devices

chat.site-daily-result@1, chat.first-chat-result@1 and chat.sound-result@1: Chat's three new internal reads (kind site-daily for Live's home series, the welcome check, and the sound a !command plays), with chat.stats-request@1 now accepting kind site-daily and the two route lists extended
network.resource.read (active, ADR-048): OpenVibe.Network's resource index, GET /api/v1/resources (common.resource-list-result@1) and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn (common.resource-summary@1)
OpenVibe.Bot is a site (navigation and the network home list it); bot.robot-profile's mapping.driver gains relay (plan T15 R9)

resource-index capabilities for media, events, host and codes are active (plan T13 step 8) and Host is live; Run and Services register, with partial resource pages, Bot button/point commands and ai.app.run

OpenVibe.Watch runs (alpha, capabilities active) and goes live with its public site (plan T18); OpenVibe.Space and AI's public home launch; Events' public origin is openvibe.events (plan T7); Community's forum capabilities retire
the developer portal moves to OpenVibe.Services and Codes becomes the harness; developer links point at OpenVibe.Services
OpenVibe.Actor becomes a service: the task router, its capabilities and schemas (plan T17, ADR-044)
OpenVibe.Food, OpenVibe.Help and OpenVibe.Work become services (plan T19); OpenVibe.Quest and OpenVibe.Rent become services
the forum returns to Community; Deals goes live, with product copy for the new sites
OpenVibe.MediaHub goes live (openvibe.download as a private drive); services declare the account events they consume (ADR-033, SDK 0.37.0)
ADR-054 — the OpenVibe inventory authority (kinds, definitions, instances, equipped and the ledger), its planned service, capabilities, schemas and events (plan T21 step 1)
OpenVibe.Inventory goes live (inventory.openvibe.network, site position 30) with six capabilities active (ADR-054, plan T21 step 2); a definition may name the services or apps that may grant it
the Workshop v1 (ADR-054 section 6): Workshop kinds, network.badge, staff review (inventory.review-request@1, inventory.definition.review active) and media_id on equipped slots
News, Reviews, Trade, Coupons and OpenRestream go live on their own domains (plan T11); the product at openre.stream is OpenRestream, with OpenVibe Live on by default (live.openre.slot.bind)
ADR-055 (proposed): money and the inventory — primary sales first, gifting next; trading and a market stay closed, and chance is never paid for
